english.title: Failed to present authorisation and operators licence for international passenger transport service when required
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated a

(A)_[regular]_
(B)_[special regular]_

passenger transport service by use of a bus or coach, namely **(..SPECIFY MAKE AND REG..), and failed to present the authorisation, or a certified true copy thereof, and the operator’s licence for the international carriage of passengers by road, or a certified true copy thereof, when requested to do so by an authorised inspecting officer, in breach of Article 483(1) of the RPT Chapter
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1)(c) and 18 of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018.
